purpose: Teach: 的中/村長/手抜き/投じ/成し遂げ/はかっ/事由/斡旋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、市場予測が的中して大きく業績を伸ばされた
lines.en: When you were young, your market predictions were spot-on. You grew the business significantly.
lines.style: Measured, reflective pace. Slight pause between each achievement, like turning pages in memory. Warm respect underneath. Voice remains steady—not seeking agreement, just bearing witness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは地方の村長との関係を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. You valued your relationships with the local village leaders.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment, almost a meditation. Not rushed. Each word has weight. Tone is neither defensive nor boastful—simply accepting what was true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、手抜きを許さない厳しい上司だった
lines.en: When you were young, you were a strict boss who wouldn't tolerate cutting corners.
lines.style: Softer than the first line. A small wistful exhale on the opening. Pace slows slightly—acknowledging complexity, not judgment. Trailing tone suggests both respect and understanding of the cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新製品開発に巨額を投じられた
lines.en: Yes. You invested heavily in new product development.
lines.style: Calm, steady rhythm. Slight emphasis on the scale of the commitment—not to dramatize, but to honor it. Meditative tone. Voice neither defends nor questions, just records.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、海外進出を成し遂げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you achieved overseas expansion.
lines.style: Gentle admiration in the tone. Pause before speaking, as if choosing words with care. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slight warmth on 'achieved'—acknowledging the difficulty of what was done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは投資をはかった上で慎重に判断された
lines.en: Yes. You measured your investments carefully before making decisions.
lines.style: Steady, almost professorial. Emphasis on the care and deliberation—not rushed. Voice carries quiet approval. No hurry in the phrasing; each word lands with intention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、解雇の事由を慎重に確認された
lines.en: You examined the reasons for every termination with care.
lines.style: Quieter register. Slight deepening of tone—this touches something harder, but remains composed. Pace becomes slightly more deliberate. Respect for the burden this represents.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界団体の斡旋にも応じられた
lines.en: Yes. You responded to requests from industry associations as well.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing conclusion. Softest tone of the exchange. Slight warmth on the acknowledgment. Voice trails very slightly—this is the final word, the closing of a chapter. Breath underneath.
